messages:
erin: Drafting a feature to support customer-controlled upgrade embargo windows + stronger cross-tenant egress isolation for Private deployments. Need product + legal + ops alignment before RFC.
erin: Problem: field customers ask for (a) blackout windows where we must not change manifests or routing during business-critical periods, and (b) guarantees that egress ips used by one tenant won't be reused for another tenant within a cool-down window.
samir: +1. We'll need an "embargo" flag in the tenant manifest and the control-plane must respect it for scheduled rollouts. Also need a manual override flow for emergency security fixes (with audit).
samir: Proposed manifest snippet:
```
tenant: acme-io
embargo:
  enabled: true
  window_start: "2026-07-01T22:00:00Z"
  window_end: "2026-07-02T06:00:00Z"
  allow_emergency_patch: true
  emergency_approval_contacts: ["netops@acme.com"]
egress_policy:
  reuse_cooldown_days: 14
```
jules: On egress isolation: we should adopt a central lease store for egress IPs and attach a lease-expiry timestamp. When a tenant releases an IP, it remains quarantined for reuse for the cooldown period. Telemetry must emit egress_ip_reuse_attempt with tenant IDs so we can audit.
jules: For embargo behavior: control-plane should abort scheduled upgrade jobs that overlap embargo windows and surface a clear reason in console + API. We should also provide a pinned-manifest apply path that can be used during embargo with explicit customer consent.
contracts: Legal note: embargo windows + reuse guarantees affect SLAs and liability. For explicit guarantees (e.g., reuse_cooldown_days > 0) we must include terms in contract addendum (compensations, force-majeure). I'll draft a short addendum template.
ops-bot: Ticket created: PRD-10021 "Upgrade embargo & egress isolation" -> https://go/repo/PRD-10021 :spiral_notepad:
erin: Acceptance criteria (draft):
- control-plane respects embargo windows for scheduled upgrades (no delta apply during embargo)
- manual emergency patch path that requires 2 approvals and emits audit event
- egress IP lease store with cooldown enforced, telemetry for reuse attempts
- console shows embargo status and next embargo window per-tenant

samir: Rollout plan:
- Phase 0: implement manifest embargo flag + scheduler check, no UI (api-only)
- Phase 1: console display + audit events + emergency override workflow
- Phase 2: enforce egress reuse cooldown + SLA addendum sign-up for customers who opt-in

jules: For air-gapped customers we need the manifest embargo flag supported in operator-shim and a signed embargo-report that field can upload. Also, operator-shim must refuse to apply a new manifest during active embargo unless a signed override is present.
samir: Owners: embargo flag + scheduler checks -> samir (control-plane); egress lease store -> jules (network infra); console + audit events -> erin (product); legal addendum -> contracts.
erin: Launch gates proposal:
- Gate A (API-only): embargo flag respected in scheduler + 2 pilot tenants using API toggles
- Gate B (UI + audit): console shows embargo windows + emergency override + audit trail + 3 pilot tenants
- Gate C (egress SLA opt-in): lease cooldown enforced + contractual addendum + field rollbook

samir: Timelines: Gate A target 4w, Gate B target 8w, Gate C target 14w (await contracts sign-off). If contracts delay, we ship A+B and mark SLA opt-in deferred.

jules: Instrumentation: embargo_blocked_upgrade_count, embargo_override_count, egress_lease_quarantine_count, egress_ip_reuse_attempts. Wire to Redwood Console with per-tenant filtering.

erin: Action items:
- samir: implement embargo flag + scheduler integration (owner)
- jules: egress lease store design + telemetry (owner)
- erin: console embargo UI + pilot comms (owner)
- contracts: draft addendum and review (owner)

erin: ops-bot  could you add label "embargo-feature" and set due_date=2026-07-15 on PRD-10021?

ops-bot: PRD-10021 updated: +label embargo-feature +due 2026-07-15

erin: Please react with :thumbsup: to lock scope or drop comments.

samir: :+1:

jules: :+1: will start the lease-store spike

contracts: :+1: will open draft addendum next week

erin: Thanks all, I'll file short RFC and loop in field ops.
